company.name: The City College of New York

positions.title: User Experience Designer II
positions.description:
•  Work with product managers to craft new features for Appian low-code automation platform
•  Translate product vision into Appian SAIL Design prototypes that define UI layouts and interactions
•  Plan and execute usability testing for features and enhancements
•  Work with software engineers to ensure that features are delivered with the intended user experience

positions.title: Solution Engineer
positions.description:
•  Provide technical expertise to customers, resolving issues related to Appian infrastructure and design
•  Lead incident management team in handling critical production system escalations
•  Assist new Solution Engineers with training and investigating product issues

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer
positions.description:
• Build “Hearing the Americas”, a website exploring the transnational roots of American popular music
• Develop web pages and styles with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on the Omeka S platform
• Set the brand direction and develop brand guidelines, including creation of a new logo
positions.insights: Skills: Figma (Software) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML

company.name: Roy Rosenzweig Center for History and New Media

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
A Complementary Design of Behavioral Approach & Visual Analytics in Cybersecurity Research
• Research and examine how computer users interact with malware, their motivation and behaviors behind malware engagement, and potential procedures to prevent malware penetration
• Develop human-computer interfaces to run behavioral experiments
• Build a VirtualBox Penetration Testing Lab to set up a controlled environment for penetration testing
• Create and design screen-block and pop-up messages with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap

positions.title: Information Systems Associate Intern
positions.description:
• Research and perform data aggregation and analysis in support of projects and operations
• Participate in workflow process diagram discussions and utilize BiZZDesign for process mapping
• Assist in updating the data warehouse repository to support internal and customer facing reporting
• Support End-to-End testing analysis and the development of the Test Execution and Management Tool
• Recipient of GDIT Acknowledgement Awards: Inspirational Intern and Servant-Leader Intern Awards

positions.title: Graphic Design Assistant | Center for Multicultural Student Services
positions.description:
• Manage organizational exposure and identity
• Create marketing materials such as flyers, brochures, posters, and calendars to promote events
• Use Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe InDesign to create graphic elements
• Coordinate and prioritize all design requests from student organizations under CMSS

positions.title: Leader for International Orientation Program, Center for Global Engagement
positions.description:
• Serve as an orientation guide to over 160 first-year, exchange, and transfer international students
• Advocate and maintain supportive environment for the globally-minded community
• Identify new needs and create solutions for issues faced by international student community
• Host a two-day annual International Student Leadership Conference

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant, JMU Computing Labs
positions.description:
• Consult with students, faculty, and staff in the labs regarding software and hardware questions
• Ensure all Computer Lab policies and procedures are followed
• Keep up-to-date on “class specific” software packages that are currently in the labs
• Troubleshoot basic hardware and software problems and submit work orders for all lab problems

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science and Media Arts & Design

honors.title: I-WEEK Photo and Video Contest 2019 | Center for Global Engagement
honors.description:
- Honorary Mention Award Winner for I-WEEK Photo and Video Contest 2019
.
.
.
19th Annual International Week Photo and Video Contest is hosted by the Center for Global Engagement at James Madison University.  The 2019 International Week theme "Building Understanding, Breaking Down Barriers: 40 Years of Global Engagement at JMU". Since 2000, members of the JMU community have submitted photographs documenting their travels around the globe.
